title: GraphQL with Spring
intro: GraphQL interview questions test whether you understand the query-language alternative to REST — schema design (types, queries, mutations, subscriptions), resolvers, the N+1 problem and DataLoader, schema federation, persisted queries, error handling, security (depth limiting, query cost analysis), and the integration patterns with Spring for GraphQL. Expect the interviewer to compare GraphQL to REST and ask when you would choose each — that question is covered in depth here.
